title: Unit 731 human experiments

tellings.quote: Unit 731, a secret biological and chemical warfare research and development program under the Imperial Japanese Army, was established in Manuria under the command of General Shiro Ishi.

plain: Unit 731 was a secret biological and chemical warfare research program of the Imperial Japanese Army, set up in Manchuria under General Shiro Ishii and known for experiments on people. Michels describes it himself, without naming a source, in an episode on human experiments and the drug industry. He brings it up as an example of how far secret programs have gone in testing on humans.
